# PlugFn

> Self-hosted provider connections, OAuth, webhooks, workflows, and sync jobs.

## Documentation

- [Browser client](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/plugfn/docs/content/docs/browser-client.md) — Use only the narrow browser-safe route helper.
- [CLI and administration](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/plugfn/docs/content/docs/cli-and-admin.md) — Use local diagnostics and a scoped admin adapter.
- [Connections and OAuth](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/plugfn/docs/content/docs/connections-and-oauth.md) — Start, inspect, and disconnect owned provider connections.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/plugfn/docs/content/docs/getting-started.md) — Configure a TypeScript runtime and mount owned routes.
- [PlugFn](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/plugfn/docs/content/docs/index.md) — A shared integration runtime for provider connections and workflows.
- [Operations](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/plugfn/docs/content/docs/operations.md) — Run the release gate and consult incident runbooks.
- [Provider readiness](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/plugfn/docs/content/docs/provider-readiness.md) — Use per-provider status and the release gate together.
- [Python runtime](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/plugfn/docs/content/docs/python.md) — Assess the experimental Python surface per provider.
- [Client SDK boundary](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/plugfn/docs/content/docs/reference/client-boundary.md) — Generated mirror of the release-gated PlugFn source guide.
- [Source reference](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/plugfn/docs/content/docs/reference/index.md) — Authoritative readiness, browser, and release contracts.
- [Provider readiness matrix](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/plugfn/docs/content/docs/reference/readiness.md) — Generated mirror of the release-gated PlugFn source guide.
- [Release gates](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/plugfn/docs/content/docs/reference/release-gates.md) — Generated mirror of the release-gated PlugFn source guide.
- [Security boundaries](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/plugfn/docs/content/docs/security-boundaries.md) — Keep credentials and privileged work on the server.
- [Webhooks](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/plugfn/docs/content/docs/webhooks.md) — Verify provider events before processing them.
- [Workflows and sync](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/plugfn/docs/content/docs/workflows-and-sync.md) — Run provider actions and persisted integration jobs.
